title: A language family tree

milestone.title: From Machine Code to Modern Languages

description:
Trace which languages influenced which.

```
Python <- ABC <- SETL
Python <- C <- B <- BCPL
Rust <- C++ <- C <- B <- BCPL
Rust <- OCaml <- ML
oldest ancestor of Rust: BCPL (1967)
```
hints: A language with no parents has one path: itself. Otherwise, add it to the front of each path of each parent (lesson 5.05).
The oldest ancestor is the one with the smallest year among all the languages on all the paths.
requirements: A dictionary from each language to its year and the languages it came from.
A recursive function prints every path back to a language with no parents.
Find the oldest ancestor of a language.
stretch: Add more languages you know about, like Java, C# and JavaScript.
